/v1/responses.contract: compatible request/response shape and streaming events
/v1/responses.retention: bounded in-memory store; records are lost on server restart

/v1/responses/:response_id.contract: lookup of process-local stored response records
/v1/responses/:response_id.retention: not available after server restart or memory-store eviction

/v1/responses/:response_id/cancel.contract: preview lifecycle route for process-local response records
/v1/responses/:response_id/cancel.retention: does not provide durable active-response cancellation semantics

/v1/responses/:response_id/input_items.contract: input-item lookup for process-local stored response records
/v1/responses/:response_id/input_items.retention: not available after server restart or memory-store eviction

/v1/realtime.contract: OpenAI Realtime GA events over WebSocket: session, input audio buffer, conversation items, responses, transcription; no WebRTC, SIP or MCP
/v1/realtime.retention: the conversation lives as long as the socket

/v1/realtime/client_secrets.contract: ephemeral ek_ keys bound to a session config, admitting /v1/realtime and /v1/realtime/media-stream only
/v1/realtime/client_secrets.retention: keys live in memory for at most two hours and are lost on server restart

/v1/realtime/media-stream.contract: telephony media-stream WebSocket: connected, start, media, mark, dtmf, stop in; media, mark, clear and Izwi's transcript and error out; base64 8 kHz mu-law; one call per socket, run as a /v1/realtime session
/v1/realtime/media-stream.retention: the call lives as long as the socket

/v1/audio/speech/batch.contract: SGLang-Omni/vLLM-Omni batch envelope {id, results[], total, succeeded, failed}; inline base64 audio; at most IZWI_TTS_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS items
/v1/audio/speech/batch.retention: results are returned in the response only

/v1/audio/speech/{speech_id}.contract: outcome of a /v1/audio/speech request (any delivery mode), keyed by X-Izwi-Speech-Id
/v1/audio/speech/{speech_id}.retention: bounded in-memory store; outcomes are evicted after IZWI_SPEECH_OUTCOME_TTL_SECS and lost on server restart

/v1/audio/speech/stream.contract: text-in TTS WebSocket: session.config, input.text, input.commit, input.done, input.cancel, session.close; dialects izwi, sglang-omni, vllm-omni
/v1/audio/speech/stream.retention: the session lives as long as the socket
